_why: Owner ruling 2026-08-19: 'I would prefer a specific link for each row, but if you
can't provide it then give me the generic link and label it as such.'
So provenance has THREE tiers, in preference order:
1. record  — resolves to THAT record. NC OneMap can do this (an ArcGIS /query
filtered to cntyname + parno; verified live: 1 row for a real
2. generic — the right place to look, LABELLED as general rather than
record-level. Useful, and honest as long as it is labelled.
3. how_to_verify — instructions, when not even a generic page exists.
Every URL below was fetched 2026-08-19 and returned a real status.
A 403 is kept where the page genuinely exists for a human in a browser and
merely refuses our crawler — that is a fine link for Matt to CLICK, and we
make no claim to have fetched it. A DNS failure is not kept: that URL is
simply wrong (fannincountyga.gov does not resolve; fannincountytax.com does).
⛔ NEVER a host from sources.denied.yaml. gsccca.org is denied because it
requires an account we never create, so citing it claims a source we do not
